steps: Collect tracked manifest fragments and canonical artifact paths
Sort keys and normalize version metadata without altering payload values
Recompute digests and compare the canonical manifest to the release index
Emit the normalized manifest only when every digest matches
Inventory the critical interactions in the checkout flow
Verify that each interaction has an accessible name and a complete keyboard path
Exercise focus order, visible focus, validation, and error recovery with keyboard-only input
Reject the review if any critical interaction lacks a keyboard path or accessible name
Allocate a new generation token without deleting the active generation
Prime representative keys through the application boundary
Switch readers atomically to the primed generation
Load-test hit rate and latency before expiring the prior generation
Capture schema-only definitions from the declared and observed databases
Classify differences as expected migrations, unmanaged drift, or ordering noise
Generate the smallest forward-only reconciliation for unmanaged drift
Recompare schemas and require an empty unmanaged difference set
Capture the intermittent failure, test command, environment, and available timing or seed data
Repeat the affected test in isolation and within its suite to measure reproducibility
Vary ordering, concurrency, and relevant environment differences to isolate the trigger
Report the smallest reproducible cause and the evidence that distinguishes it from noise
